config.rationale: Directly addresses the token-starvation hypothesis: round-1 compact_tf_p4 used patch_size=4 yielding only 49 tokens, which is below the threshold where self-attention learns meaningful relational structure. Switching to patch_size=2 produces 196 tokens (14×14 grid), giving attention 4× more pairwise interactions. Hidden increased to 128 (divisible by 4 heads, multiple of 8) to match the larger token budget and provide adequate per-token representation. Pooling switched from 'cls' to 'mean' to aggregate spatial information across all 196 tokens rather than relying on a single learned CLS token, which is more robust at this resolution. Depth kept at 4 to avoid overfitting with 90k samples. AdamW with wd=0.05 (decoupled weight decay) and cosine schedule retained from the round-1 transformer recipe. Batch size 64 keeps attention gradients stable with the larger token sequence. Dropout kept low (0.1) to preserve the already-limited attention signal.
